ayahs.tr: And when the stars fall, scattering,
And when the seas are erupted
And when the [contents of] graves are scattered,
A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
ayahs.tr: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
ayahs.tl: Yaaa ayyuhal insaaanu maa gharraka bi Rabbikal kareem

ayahs.tr: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?

ayahs.ar: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
ayahs.tr: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.
ayahs.tl: Feee ayye sooratim maa shaaa'a rakkabak

ayahs.tr: No! But you deny the Recompense.
And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,
Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,
And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.
They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,
And never therefrom will they be absent.
And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa adraaka maa Yawmud Deen

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.tr: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
ayahs.tl: Summa maaa adraaka maa Yawmud Deen

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ
ayahs.tr: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah.
ayahs.tl: Yawma laa tamliku nafsul linafsin shai'anw walamru yawma'izil lillaah
